name: assistant
description: The one assistant's own tools: a daily digest and triage from waiting.list and agents.list, and read-only pattern-noticing from what memory already surfaces about corrections and conflicts. Off by default; the person turns the digest on.

settings.label: Pushes a day
settings.help: The most times the assistant, watchers and duties may notify you in a day. Quiet hours still hold. 0 is never.

settings.label: Daily digest
settings.help: Once a day, at your device's own local start of day, the assistant puts together one paragraph: what's waiting on you, and any pattern it noticed. Off by default; ask for it any time either way with the assistant.
